_comment_shape: Standard CLIF site config. site_name / clif_version / data_directory / filetype / timezone are the consortium-standard keys; the last three are the names clifpy itself requires, so this file is passed to clifpy with no translation layer. Everything below them is this project's protocol.
_comment_versions: clif_version is always the CLIF SPEC version (e.g. 2.1.0). A conversion/ETL release -- the MIMIC-to-CLIF build 1.1.0, say -- is NOT a CLIF version and goes in dataset_version. Leave dataset_version empty for a site's own tables.
_comment_medications: Confirm these against your data before running; vocabularies differ between sources. Phase 0 asserts them and prints the med_category values it actually found, so a mismatch fails loudly rather than producing an empty cohort.
_comment_covariates: Covariate aggregation and missingness rules are PROTOCOL and live in config/covariates.json, which IS tracked in git. This file is not tracked (it carries local paths), so nothing estimand-defining may live here alone.
_comment_protocol: cohort / outcomes / model define the estimand. If two sites set these differently the pooled result is not meaningful -- do not edit them to make a run work.

outcomes._comment_mortality: patient.death_dttm is unstable across CLIF sites -- use discharge_category. Sensitivity analysis drops Hospice.

model._comment_scaling: scaling MUST be 0 -- within-unit normalisation erases absolute dose level. See docs/design_notes.md sections 3-4.
